messages:
Alex: Hey ARB — quick check on facilitator rotation for the next 6 weeks. I can take the week of Apr 5 but need someone to swap if we pick a Friday slot. Proposed agenda items: 1) RFC: kv-cache refactor (Sam) 2) Platform standards: model-pin policy update (Marta) 3) Open triage: failing dedupe test on Dedicated. Thoughts?
Rachel: I'm good to facilitate Apr 12. Can also own the Platform standards item if Marta is overloaded.
Sam: I can present the kv-cache RFC, will post slides by Tue. Need 10 minutes for design + 15 for discussion.
Marta: I can do the model-pin policy review but can we preread? I'll drop a short TL;DR in the doc.
Noah: Can we shift meeting earlier by 15 min? Several folks have overlapping SRE syncs.
Alex: +1 to earlier. How about 10:15 instead of 10:30? Saves the later block.
Infra-bot: deploy reminder — ARB doc updated: https://redwood.team/docs/arb/agenda-template.md
Sam: small ask — if we do kv-cache perf numbers, please bring p50/p95 for 256/1024 seq.
Marta: noted.
Rachel: volunteers for note-taking: @Maya?
Maya: happy to take notes.
Alex: agenda template (copy into calendar invite):
``` 
1) Quick updates (5m)
2) Presentation: kv-cache RFC (10m)
3) Platform policy review (10m)
4) Triage & action items (20m)
``` 
Alex: if anyone wants to swap facilitator weeks, ping me. I'll update the rotation doc and send invite by EOD. :thumbsup:
